assumptions: Static horizontal pitch-chain screening only. Motor torque and mass values are design inputs; bracket, cable, thermal, dynamic, stiffness, collision, and IK effects require separate verification.

segments.name: extra
segments.motor_spec_note: 4.2 Nm is a provisional static design limit (50% of 8.4 Nm stall), not a manufacturer continuous rating.

segments.name: ee_power
segments.motor_spec_note: Fixed end-effector power-transmission actuator. Its mass is included in upstream joint loads; gripping/transmission torque is outside this arm-pose calculation.

base_motor_reference.note: Base yaw sizing is not included in this planar gravity calculation.
